prompt-inspector.purpose: Shows the assembled request before it is sent, for prompt and retrieval diagnosis.

world-info-info.purpose: Reports which World Info entries activated and why.

notebook.purpose: Human-authored, profile-local notes that are not automatically promoted into model context.
